measure_words.usage: General measure word for people and objects
examples: 一个杯子 yí gè bēizi (one cup)
五个学生 wǔ gè xuésheng (five students)
三个人 sān gè rén (three people)
三口人 sān kǒu rén (three family members)
五口人 wǔ kǒu rén (five people)
我家有四口人。Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. (My family has four people.)
三岁 sān suì (three years old)
二十岁 èrshí suì (twenty years old)
你几岁了？Nǐ jǐ suì le? (How old are you?)
十八块 shíbā kuài (18 yuan)
五块 wǔ kuài (5 yuan)
这个杯子多少钱？Zhège bēizi duōshao qián? (How much is this cup? — 十八块。Shíbā kuài.)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for cups/glasses of liquid
examples: 一杯茶 yì bēi chá (a cup of tea)
一杯水 yì bēi shuǐ (a glass of water)
我想喝一杯茶。Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi chá. (I want to drink a cup of tea.)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for books and bound items
examples: 一本书 yì běn shū (a book)
两本杂志 liǎng běn zázhì (two magazines)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for animals and some objects
examples: 一只猫 yì zhī māo (a cat)
一只狗 yì zhī gǒu (a dog)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for flat objects (paper, tables, tickets)
examples: 一张纸 yì zhāng zhǐ (a piece of paper)
一张票 yì zhāng piào (a ticket)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for clothing, items, affairs
examples: 一件衣服 yì jiàn yīfu (a piece of clothing)
两件事 liǎng jiàn shì (two matters)

measure_words.usage: Measure word for objects with handles, chairs
examples: 一把椅子 yì bǎ yǐzi (a chair)
一把伞 yì bǎ sǎn (an umbrella)
